title: Cisco Networking Academy courses toward CCNA
why: Networking is the first technical screen for most security and infrastructure SE roles, and Cisco's own CSAP posting listed CCNA as preferred.

title: CompTIA Network+ video course
why: Verkada SE postings list Network+ as a plus; it is a faster credential than CCNA.

title: Home firewall lab with pfSense
why: A documented lab gives you a hands-on story and counts as proof of technical curiosity in Cisco's CSAP posting.

title: CompTIA Security+ video course
why: Security+ is the common baseline credential named in security SE postings.

title: AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials
why: Cloud is your largest gap; AWS early-career SA programs list AWS certification as preferred.

title: Linux Journey
why: Trials and POCs often run on Linux; Verkada SE postings prefer Linux experience.

title: Postman learning center: REST API basics
why: SE Desk roles at Samsara script against a public API during trials.

title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
why: A small script during a proof of concept builds technical credibility quickly.

title: Record a 3-minute product walkthrough for one target company
why: Demos are the most visible part of the SE job and a frequent interview round; a recording also works as an outreach attachment.

title: Five-minute technical explanation, recorded and reviewed
why: SE interviews almost always include a presentation or mock customer call.

title: Salesforce Trailhead: CRM basics
why: Shows CRM fluency beyond a single tool and helps with Salesforce's own ASE program.

title: Write and rehearse 10 discovery questions for one target buyer
why: Discovery separates SEs from product experts and is tested in role plays.
